visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-definition close-up of the finished stir-fry noodle dish in a pan, topped with green chives and tender pork slices. The lighting is bright and warm, highlighting the oily sheen of the noodles. (2) Hands are shown preparing ingredients: slicing raw pink pork into thin strips on a cutting board, then placing them in a metal bowl. Seasonings like soy sauce and white pepper are added using a wooden spoon. (3) The scene transitions to the preparation of vegetables; a chef's knife slices a white onion, green onions, and chives into uniform segments on a light-colored board. (4) Noodles are parboiled in a red pot of boiling water, then transferred using a strainer into a bowl of ice water to preserve their texture. (5) The cooking sequence begins with oil being poured into a black pan, followed by the seasoned pork strips which are stir-fried until they turn golden brown. (6) Onions, garlic, and kimchi are added in stages, with the pan being tossed frequently. The noodles are then added and mixed thoroughly with the sauce. (7) In the final phase, a woman wearing a white shirt and a pink apron is shown tasting the noodles. She smiles broadly, chews with enjoyment, and uses chopsticks to lift large portions of the noodles to the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 簡單又超美味的『松阪豬肉泡菜炒拉麵』. (2) [Subtitle]: 準備一份松阪豬切成小薄片. (3) [Subtitle]: 醃漬調味：一小攝鹽、一小匙糖、一小撮白胡椒、5cc醬油、15ml酒. (4) [Subtitle]: 充分搓揉均勻直到產生黏性為止. (5) [Subtitle]: 先放冰箱靜置一下. (6) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥一顆切成粗絲... (7) [Subtitle]: 蔥白斜切. (8) [Subtitle]: 蔥綠切成長段. (9) [Subtitle]: 韭菜頭的部分切切成段.. (10) [Subtitle]: 韭菜切成長段... (11) [Subtitle]: 跟蔥綠放在一起. (12) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭剁成蒜末. (13) [Subtitle]: 韓式辣椒粉(粗)不辣. (14) [Subtitle]: 韓泡菜約200克 (建議挑選酸一點的). (15) [Subtitle]: 先將拉麵放入滾水裡煮，不需要煮熟，燙一下即可. (16) [Subtitle]: 撈起來放入冰水裡. (17) [Subtitle]: 沖洗掉黏液. (18) [Subtitle]: 瀝乾水分. (19) [Subtitle]: 這樣等一下炒麵才不會過熟. (20) [Subtitle]: 熱鍋後，放入橄欖油. (21) [Subtitle]: 等油熱了，把肉片放進來煎. (22) [Subtitle]: 先讓一面煎一下. (23) [Subtitle]: 接著再翻炒. (24) [Subtitle]: 大約炒至7分熟...放入蔥白跟韭菜頭、蒜末. (25) [Subtitle]: 翻炒出香氣. (26) [Subtitle]: 這時候放入一匙的韓式辣椒粉(不辣). (27) [Subtitle]: 先將豬肉片炒到紅紅的樣子. (28) [Subtitle]: 再放入洋蔥絲... (29) [Subtitle]: 充分拌炒均勻... (30) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥不要炒太久，要保留一點洋蔥的脆度. (31) [Subtitle]: 現在把拉麵放進來. (32) [Subtitle]: 快速的拌炒均勻. (33) [Subtitle]: 讓味道融合. (34) [Subtitle]: 最後把蔥綠跟韭菜放進來. (35) [Subtitle]: 翻拌均勻... (36) [Subtitle]: 鍋底嗆入10ml的減鹽醬油增加醬香味. (37) [Subtitle]: 最後關火前放入泡菜+泡菜汁... (38) [Subtitle]: 快速的拌一拌，不能煮太久，會失去酸味喔！. (39) [Subtitle]: 關火後，加入剩餘的蒜末還有一大匙的醋增加酸味！. (40) [Subtitle]: 補一些芝麻油增加香氣❤️. (41) [Slogan]: 簡單又超美味的『松阪豬肉泡菜炒拉麵』就完成啦～😉❤️. (42) [Variety]: 不管是烏龍麵還是拉麵都好吃！❤️😉. (43) [Variety]: 松阪豬好吃😉. (44) [Subtitle]: 那我要開動囉～😉. (45) [Subtitle]: 麵 Q Q 的好吃❤️😉. (46) [Subtitle]: 有泡菜的酸味、一點辣味還有脆脆的蔬菜❤️😉. (47) [Subtitle]: 松阪豬大推！！😉. [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.
